v2_invalidation: ManipSpaceEnv.action_space constructs a fresh Box on every property access, so seeding a previously returned Box did not control the Box sampled internally during goal-observation construction
hypothesis: after the action-space object used inside reset is both cached and seeded, exact replay will be deterministic and reveal whether residual failure is sequential closed-loop planning or failure to make contact
exact_change: during reset only, expose one seeded action-space instance through the unwrapped environment class property and restore the original property in a finally block; preserve checkpoints, policy RNG, environment RNG, task, episode seeds, horizon, and NFE
expected_if_true: two action_weight-10 invocations have exactly identical episode records and at least two episodes show button transitions plus positive best progress
expected_if_false: episode records still differ, or at least two action_weight-10 episodes have no transition or no positive best progress

interpretation.sequential_signal: at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes have button transitions and positive best progress
interpretation.regression_signal: positive best progress followed by worse final Hamming distance
interpretation.contact_failure_signal: no button transitions in at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes
interpretation.scope: mechanism diagnostic only; three paired episodes are not a benchmark estimate
